decisions.RETRIEVE: Authorized, relevant, and current enough to use directly.
decisions.RETRIEVE_WITH_CONTEXT: Authorized and relevant but not from this conversation (or inferred); it may be used only with its origin stated.
decisions.DEFER: Not retrieved for this turn: insufficient relevance, confidence, or necessity. The memory is retained, not deleted.
decisions.REJECT: Refused outright: owner mismatch, wrong session, tampered provenance, or an unauthorized scope. Never reaches the model.

nonNegotiable: A conversation never silently inherits another conversation's transcript or active emotional context.
Historical information stays historical: it is never presented as something said now.
An inference is never promoted to an established fact.
Session memory never becomes persistent memory by accident.

relevance.measure: share of the request's SUBJECT words covered by the memory, after instruction words (fix/help/can/it) are removed
relevance.why: A request made only of instructions names nothing about the user. Lexical overlap on such a request cannot authorize history.
relevance.sensitiveSource: deterministic lexicon (bereavement, illness, crisis) plus the 2.1 EmotionAppraisal reading at intensity >= 0.7 and unguarded

stageEnforcement.eligibility: PatternMemory.search -> isEligible() — owner, session and provenance-integrity checks happen before ranking
stageEnforcement.authorization: MemoryBridge.enrich -> authorize() — scope, relevance and confidence decide RETRIEVE / RETRIEVE_WITH_CONTEXT / DEFER / REJECT
stageEnforcement.rendering: MemorySynthesizer.formatGroup -> originLabel() — historical and inferred lines carry their origin
stageEnforcement.instruction: memoryContextNote() — added only when labelled material is present
